errors.WALK_IN_REFUND_IN_MONEY: {order} was a walk-in sale, so it is refunded in money, not as credit.
errors.VERSION_REQUIRED: This order changed while you were looking at it. Reload and try again.
errors.PO_HAS_NO_ITEMS: This purchase order has no items. Add what was ordered before the cycle leaves purchasing.
errors.DUPLICATE_SUPPLIER_INVOICE: Invoice {ref} from {supplier} is already recorded on {purchaseOrder}.
errors.ASSISTANT_PARTNERS_ONLY: Only core partners can use the assistant.
errors.CONFIRMATION_INVALID: This confirmation is not valid. Show the preview again and confirm that.
errors.CONFIRMATION_EXPIRED: This confirmation has expired. Show the preview again and confirm it within 15 minutes.
errors.CONFIRMATION_USED: This confirmation has already been used. Nothing more was saved.
errors.CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH: This confirmation was given for a different request. Nothing was saved — show the new preview and confirm that.
errors.DATE_RANGE_REVERSED: The range starts on {from}, after it ends on {to}.
errors.BAD_DATE: "{value}" is not a date written YYYY-MM-DD.
errors.CYCLE_CODE_AMBIGUOUS: "{code}" matches more than one cycle when case is ignored: {matches}. Give the code exactly.
errors.DISCOUNT_PERCENT_INVALID: A line discount must be between 0 and 100 percent.
errors.NEW_PRODUCT_REPEATED: {product} is listed as a new product more than once.
errors.PO_TERMS_MISMATCH: Purchase order {reference} is in {currency} at {rate} EGP; add lines only in that currency and rate.
errors.PO_HAS_OTHER_INVOICE: Purchase order {reference} already records invoice {invoice}; record {ref} as a separate order.
errors.CYCLE_STATUS_CHANGED: Cycle {cycle} is {status} now, not {expected}. Nothing was changed — preview again.
errors.CYCLE_FINAL_NO_LEGS: Cycle {cycle} is {status}, so no shipping leg can be added to it.
errors.PREVIEW_CHANGED: What this would save has changed since the preview. Nothing was saved — show the new preview and confirm that.
errors.CYCLE_CLOSED: Cycle {cycle} was cancelled, so nothing can be recorded on its shipment.
errors.CYCLE_SETTLING: Cycle {cycle} is being settled or is closed, so nothing can be recorded on its shipment. Reverse the settlement first.
errors.DELIVERY_BEFORE_DEPARTURE: A delivery on {day} is before {leg} departed on {departedOn}.
errors.DELIVERY_EXCEEDS_IN_TRANSIT: Only {onTheWay} of {line} are on the way, so a delivery of {asked} cannot be recorded.
errors.DELIVERY_IN_USE: This delivery cannot be deleted: stock was received from it, a later leg carried its goods on, or the cycle has moved on because of it.
errors.LEG_COST_LOCKED: Goods of cycle {cycle} have already been received or marked lost, so this leg’s cost is fixed. Record a late or corrected charge as a cycle expense.
errors.LEG_COST_LOCKED_SETTLEMENT: Cycle {cycle} has a settlement, or is being settled, closed or cancelled, so this leg’s cost can no longer be recalculated. Record a late or corrected charge as a cycle expense.
errors.LEG_COST_LOCKED_LOSSES: Goods of cycle {cycle} were marked lost at the current cost, so this leg’s cost can no longer be recalculated. Record a late or corrected charge as a cycle expense.
errors.LEG_COST_LOCKED_TRANSFERS: Stock was moved into or out of cycle {cycle} at the current cost, so this leg’s cost can no longer be recalculated. Record a late or corrected charge as a cycle expense.
errors.LEG_COST_LOCKED_OVERRIDE: {product} in cycle {cycle} was received at a cost entered by hand, which recalculating would replace, so this leg’s cost is fixed. Record a late or corrected charge as a cycle expense.
errors.LEG_COST_LOCKED_LEDGER: The purchase entries for {product} in cycle {cycle} do not match its received stock, so this leg’s cost cannot be recalculated. Record a late or corrected charge as a cycle expense.
errors.LEG_COST_UNCHANGED: The cost given is what {leg} of cycle {cycle} costs already, so nothing would change.
errors.LEG_COST_NEGATIVE: A shipping leg’s cost, rate, pieces or weight cannot be negative.
errors.LOSS_EXCEEDS_IN_TRANSIT: Only {onTheWay} of {line} are still to come, so {asked} cannot be marked lost.
errors.LOSS_REFUNDED: This loss has a refund standing against it, so it cannot be taken back: the goods would be counted twice. Undo the refund first.
errors.AMOUNT_NOT_POSITIVE: A payment must be more than zero.
errors.PAYMENT_EXCEEDS_ORDER: Order {order} owes {owed}, so {asked} cannot be paid on it.
errors.ORDER_NOT_CONFIRMED: Order {order} is a draft, so it owes nothing yet.
errors.ORDER_OWES_NOTHING: Order {order} owes nothing, so nothing can be paid on it.
errors.CYCLE_NOT_ARRIVED: Cycle {cycle} is {status}. Stock can be received once the cycle has arrived in Egypt.
errors.NOT_LAST_LEG_DELIVERY: This delivery reached the UAE, not Egypt. Stock is received from deliveries on the leg that ends in Egypt.
errors.DELIVERY_REQUIRED: {deliveries} deliveries of {product} are waiting to be received. Choose the delivery the goods came in.
errors.RECEIVED_EXCEEDS_DELIVERED: {received} of {product} cannot be received: only {available} are waiting to be received from this delivery.
errors.SHIPMENT_NOT_ACCOUNTED: Cycle {cycle} cannot be settled yet: {onTheWay} unit(s) are still on the way and {waiting} delivered but not received, across {lines} order line(s). Receive them, or mark them lost, first.
errors.WALK_IN_NO_STATEMENT: A walk-in buyer has no account, so there is no statement.
errors.INVOICE_DRAFT: Order {order} is a draft, so it has no invoice yet. Confirm it first.
errors.INVOICE_CANCELLED: Order {order} was cancelled, so it has no invoice.
errors.LENDER_REPAYMENT_EXCEEDS_OWED: {amount} EGP is more than is owed: {owed} is left, which {settling} EGP pays off at {rate}.
errors.LENDER_REPAYMENT_CLEARS_NOTHING: {amount} EGP at {rate} clears nothing of the debt.
errors.LENDER_DEBT_OUTSTANDING: Cycle {cycle} cannot be settled while it still owes: {owed}. Repay them first.
errors.CYCLE_HAS_LENDER_FINANCING: Cycle {cycle} has an order a friend paid for; remove his payment before cancelling it.
errors.CYCLE_CLOSED_FOR_FINANCING: Cycle {cycle} is {status}; a friend's payment cannot be recorded on it.
errors.LENDER_ALREADY_FINANCES_ORDER: {lender} already paid for {reference}. Remove that and record it again to change it.
errors.FINANCING_EXCEEDS_CYCLE_COST: {amount} EGP is more than is left of cycle {cycle}'s cost: it cost {cost} EGP (goods, shipping and the expenses charged to it), friends already paid {financed} EGP, so {available} EGP is left.
errors.FINANCING_HAS_REPAYMENTS: {lender} has been repaid on this; reverse those repayments before removing it.
errors.LENDER_REPAYMENT_BEFORE_FINANCING: He paid the supplier on {paidOn}; a repayment cannot be dated before that.
errors.LENDER_REPAYMENT_ALREADY_REVERSED: This repayment was already reversed. Reversing again would count it twice.
errors.LENDER_CYCLE_SETTLED: Cycle {cycle} is settled; reverse the settlement before undoing a repayment on it.
errors.LENDER_NOTHING_OWED: {lender} is owed nothing on this, so there is nothing to schedule.
errors.LENDER_NOT_OWED: {lender} is owed nothing, so there is nothing to repay.
errors.LENDER_PLAN_EXISTS: This already has an active plan. Cancel it before agreeing another.
errors.LENDER_PLAN_EXCEEDS_OWED: The instalments total {total} {currency} but only {owed} is owed.
errors.FINANCING_ORDER_EMPTY: {reference} has no lines, so there is nothing a friend could have paid for.
errors.DEPARTURE_EXCEEDS_WAITING: Only {waiting} of {line} are waiting to leave, so a departure of {asked} cannot be recorded.
errors.DEPARTURE_BEFORE_ORDER: {line} was ordered on {orderedOn}, so it cannot have left on {day}.
errors.DEPARTURE_BEFORE_ARRIVAL: Only {available} of {line} had reached the start of {leg} and not left by {day}, so {asked} cannot have left that day.
errors.DEPARTURE_IN_USE: This departure cannot be undone: goods from it were delivered or marked lost, or the cycle has moved on because of it.
errors.DELIVERY_BEFORE_GOODS_LEFT: Only {available} of {line} had left on {leg} by {day}, so a delivery of {asked} that day cannot be recorded.
errors.LEG_HAS_SEVERAL_DEPARTURES: {leg} left in {departures} departures, so its date cannot be changed here. Undo the wrong departure on the cycle page and record it again.
errors.LEDGER_CATEGORY_NOT_MANUAL: “{category}” is not a category a manual entry can use. Choose one from the list.
errors.LEDGER_DIRECTION_MISMATCH: This is {kind}, so it cannot be recorded as {direction}.
errors.LEDGER_TYPE_NOT_MANUAL: A {type} entry is written by its own flow, not by hand.
errors.LEDGER_AMOUNT_NOT_POSITIVE: An amount must be more than zero.
errors.LEDGER_RATE_NOT_POSITIVE: The rate from {currency} to EGP must be more than zero.
errors.LEDGER_EGP_RATE: An amount in pounds converts to pounds at 1.
errors.LEDGER_CYCLE_REQUIRED: {category} is a cost of one cycle’s goods — choose the cycle it belongs to.
errors.LEDGER_CYCLE_NOT_OPEN: Cycle {cycle} is {status}, so nothing more can be charged to it.
errors.TRANSFER_SOURCE_NOT_SELLING: Cycle {cycle} is {status}. Leftovers can be moved only from a cycle that is selling or being settled.
errors.TRANSFER_SOURCE_PAID: Cycle {cycle} has been paid out; its stock can no longer move.
errors.TRANSFER_SOURCE_NOT_ACCOUNTED: Cycle {cycle} still has {onTheWay} unit(s) on the way and {waiting} delivered but not received; account for every unit before moving leftovers.
errors.TRANSFER_TARGET_CLOSED: Cycle {cycle} is {status} and cannot take stock in.
errors.TRANSFER_SAME_CYCLE: Leftovers cannot be moved from {cycle} to itself.
errors.TRANSFER_QTY_NOT_POSITIVE: The quantity of {product} to move must be more than zero.
errors.TRANSFER_MORE_THAN_ON_SHELF: Only {available} of {product} can be moved; {requested} was asked for.
errors.TRANSFER_DUPLICATE_PRODUCT: {product} is listed twice; give one quantity per product.
errors.TRANSFER_NO_LINES: Say how many of which product to move.
errors.TRANSFER_ALREADY_UNDONE: This move has already been undone.
errors.TRANSFER_UNITS_SOLD: Some of the {product} moved to {cycle} has been sold or used there; the move is permanent now.
errors.CYCLE_HAS_TRANSFERS_IN: Cycle {cycle} holds leftover stock moved in from another cycle; undo that move before cancelling it.
errors.DESCRIPTION_AR_TOO_LONG: The Arabic description can be at most {max} characters.
errors.LEDGER_CATEGORY_RESERVED: Moving leftover stock between cycles is recorded from the cycle page, not as a ledger entry.
errors.NAME_AR_TOO_LONG: The Arabic name can be at most {max} characters.
errors.RUNNING_COST_CHARGED: This running cost was already taken from a payout ({cycles}). Reverse that settlement first, then this entry.
errors.PRODUCT_INACTIVE: {product} is deactivated, so no more of it can be ordered. Reactivate it to buy more.
errors.PRODUCT_STATUS_INVALID: A product is either active or inactive.
errors.NOT_ENOUGH_STOCK_ON_DATE: Only {available} of {product} had been received by {day}, so {wanted} cannot have been sold that day.
errors.PAYMENT_BEFORE_ORDER: A payment received on {receivedOn} cannot pay {order}, which was sold on {orderedOn}.
errors.RECEIVED_BEFORE_ARRIVAL: Stock cannot be received on {day}: the delivery reached Egypt on {arrivedOn}.
errors.FINANCING_RATE_REQUIRED: He paid in {currency}, which is not {reference}'s currency: say what {currency} was worth in pounds on the day he paid.
errors.RATE_TOO_PRECISE: A rate has at most {decimals} decimals; {rate} has more.
errors.CURRENCY_CODE_INVALID: {value} is not a currency code: three letters, such as AED.
errors.CURRENCY_EXISTS: {currency} is already on the exchange-rate page; change its rate there.
errors.SALE_CONTRACT_NOT_OPEN: Order {order} is not confirmed or partly paid, so it cannot be sold on instalments.
errors.SALE_CONTRACT_NOT_EGP: Order {order} is in {currency}; instalment contracts are in EGP.
errors.SALE_CONTRACT_NOTHING_OWED: Nothing is outstanding on order {order}, so there is nothing to put on instalments.
errors.SALE_HAS_PLAN: Order {order} already has its instalment plan ({reference}).
errors.CONTRACT_SUM_MISMATCH: The instalments total {total} EGP but {owed} EGP is outstanding on order {order}.
errors.INSTALMENT_DUE_IN_PAST: An instalment cannot fall due in the past ({day}).
errors.SALE_HAS_NO_PLAN: Order {order} has no instalment plan, so it has no contract.
errors.LENDER_HAS_FINANCINGS: He still has {count} payment(s) on record. Remove them first, then delete him.
errors.PERIOD_NOT_STARTED: The period starts on {from}, which has not come yet.
errors.SAMPLES_NEED_SHOP: Samples are left with a shop, so choose the customer — a walk-in cannot take samples.
errors.SAMPLES_ALREADY_DECIDED: {order} is no longer samples at the shop ({status}); what the shop decided is already recorded.
errors.NOT_SAMPLES: {order} is not samples left at a shop.
errors.INVOICE_SAMPLES: {order} is samples left at a shop, not a sale, so it has no invoice.
errors.CYCLE_HAS_SAMPLES_OUT: {units} unit(s) of cycle {cycle} are out as samples at {shops}. Record what the shops decided — bought, returned or written off — before settling.
errors.SAMPLES_NOT_PAYABLE: {order} is samples left at a shop, not a sale, so nothing can be paid on it. Record what the shop decided first.
errors.SAMPLES_NOTHING_KEPT: Nothing is on the sale from {order}. If every sample came back, record "Returned".
errors.SAMPLES_OTHER_SHOP: The samples on {order} were left with {shop}; the sale from them is to {shop}.
errors.SAMPLES_SALE_BEFORE_LEFT: The samples on {order} were left on {left}, so the sale cannot be dated {day}.
errors.SAMPLES_EXTRA_NOT_IN_STOCK: {out} of {product} went out as samples; selling {wanted} needs {extra} more from the shelf, and only {available} is there.
errors.SAMPLES_RETURN_MORE_THAN_OUT: Only {out} of {product} went out on {order}; {returned} cannot come back.
errors.SAMPLES_RETURN_NOT_ALL: {out} of {product} went out on {order} and {returned} came back. "Returned" takes back everything; if the shop kept the rest, record it as a sale from the samples.
errors.FUNDING_LOCKED_AFTER_SETTLEMENT: The funding of {cycle} can no longer change: {reason}.
errors.SETTLEMENT_STALE_FUNDING: The funding changed after this settlement was calculated. Calculate it again before approving.
errors.PRICE_ADJUSTMENT_ORDER_NOT_OPEN: Only a confirmed sale that is still owed can have its price lowered. {order} is {status}.
errors.PRICE_ADJUSTMENT_UNDER_CONTRACT: {order} is sold on instalments ({plan}). Cancel the contract, lower the price, then draw a new one.
errors.PRICE_ADJUSTMENT_BAD_PRICE: The new price must be a number, zero or more.
errors.PRICE_ADJUSTMENT_NOT_LOWER: {product} is at {current} a unit; a price can only be lowered here.
errors.PRICE_ADJUSTMENT_NOTHING_HELD: Every unit of {product} on {order} has been returned; there is nothing to lower the price of.
errors.PRICE_ADJUSTMENT_BEFORE_SALE: {order} was sold on {sold}; its price cannot be lowered on {day}.
errors.PRICE_ADJUSTMENT_CYCLE_SETTLED: These units came from cycle {cycle}, which is being settled or is settled; its sales can no longer change.
errors.PRICE_ADJUSTMENT_EXCEEDS_OWED: Lowering {product} takes {amount} off, but {order} owes only {owed}. Anything beyond what is owed is a refund.
errors.AI_NOT_CONFIGURED: The chat isn't set up yet: the API needs an AI key.
errors.AI_QUESTION_TOO_LONG: A question can be at most {max} characters.
errors.AI_DAILY_LIMIT: Today's {limit} chat messages are used up. The chat opens again tomorrow.
errors.AI_PROVIDER_FAILED: The AI service did not answer. Try again in a moment.
errors.AI_PROVIDER_BUSY: The AI service is busy or its free allowance is used up for now. Try again later.
errors.AI_PROVIDER_TOO_SMALL: This AI provider's allowance is too small for one question with the assistant's tools. Switch to one with a larger allowance (Gemini's free tier fits).

push.title: Alerts on this device
push.deviceScope: A subscription belongs to one browser on one device. Turning alerts on here does nothing for your other devices, and turning them off does not silence them either.
push.intro: Get an alert when a shop asks to buy or asks for an import, even when this app is closed.
push.on: Alerts are on for this device.
push.failed: Alerts could not be turned on for this device.
push.installToGetAlerts: To get alerts on this iPhone, add S&F System to your home screen first — Safari cannot send them otherwise.
push.alertsBlockedTitle: Alerts are blocked for this site. The browser will not ask again, so turn them on here:
push.iosStep1: Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari
push.iosStep2: Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen"
push.iosStep4: Open S&F System from your home screen and come back to this page
push.installStep1: Install S&F System from your browser menu — look for "Install app" or "Add to Home screen"
push.installStep2: Open it from your home screen and come back to this page
push.blockedIosStep1: Open Settings, then Apps, then Safari
push.blockedIosStep2: Tap Notifications and allow them for this site
push.blockedIosStep3: Come back here and press the button again
push.blockedSafariStep1: In the menu bar: Safari → Settings → Websites → Notifications
push.blockedSafariStep2: Find this site, set it to Allow, then press the button again
push.blockedFirefoxStep1: Click the padlock in the address bar, then open Permissions
push.blockedFirefoxStep2: Set Notifications to Allow, reload, then press the button again
push.blockedChromeStep1: Click the padlock or the icon at the start of the address bar
push.blockedChromeStep2: Set Notifications to Allow, reload, then press the button again

claudeConnections.title: Claude connections
claudeConnections.intro: Each Claude app you sign in — the phone, a laptop — is its own connection. Disconnecting one ends its access at once, without changing your password.
claudeConnections.empty: Claude is not connected to your account.
claudeConnections.howTo: To connect, open Claude, go to Settings → Connectors, add a custom connector, and paste this server URL. Claude will ask you to sign in with your usual login.
claudeConnections.confirmAll: Every Claude app signed in to your account loses access now. To use one again, you will have to sign it in again.
claudeConnections.failed: Could not disconnect. Please try again.
claudeConnections.loadFailed: Your Claude connections could not be loaded.
